title: OptScientist: Automated Discovery of Optimization Laws

paragraphs.en: 总结：MIT团队推出OptScientist框架，可从数据中自动发现符号化优化规律，在物理、行为与社会科学基准上大幅超越现有方法。 Many scientific phenomena are best understood as outcomes of underlying optimization problems, yet automated scientific discovery has largely focused on recovering equations that describe observed input-output patterns. We introduce OptScientist, a novel automated framework for discovering compact symbolic optimization laws directly from data. OptScientist comprises (i) a model that infers symbolic optimization problems by first learning to represent data as an optimization problem and then extracting its symbolic form, and (ii) an LLM agentic system embedding the model in a discovery process that integrates theoretical priors from scientific literature, discovers candidate laws, abstracts their underlying mechanisms, and suggests new data to collect. We first evaluate OptScientist on OptFeynman, a novel benchmark of 99 physics-derived optimization problems, where OptScientist recovers ground-truth laws for over 80% of the problems and remains robust to noisy contextual information, while substantially outperforming machine-learning, symbolic, and LLM-based model-discovery baselines. On human risky choice and central-bank monetary policy, OptScientist discovers compact symbolic optimization laws that achieve held-out predictive performance competitive with leading baselines, while using few parameters and substantially fewer tokens than LLM baselines. Overall, OptScientist extends automated scientific discovery to uncovering optimization laws that generate observed phenomena, enabling automated theory building across the physical, biological, behavioral, and social sciences.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：MIT团队推出OptScientist框架，可从数据中自动发现符号化优化规律，在物理、行为与社会科学基准上大幅超越现有方法。许多科学现象最好被理解为底层优化问题的结果，然而自动化科学发现大多聚焦于恢复描述观测到的输入输出模式的方程。 我们提出OptScientist，这是一个新颖的自动化框架，可直接从数据中发现简洁的符号化优化规律。 OptScientist包括：(i) 一个通过先将数据表示为优化问题、再提取其符号形式来推断符号化优化问题的模型；(ii) 一个将上述模型嵌入发现过程的LLM智能体系统，该系统整合来自科学文献的理论先验、发现候选规律、抽象其底层机制，并建议需要收集的新数据。 我们首先在OptFeynman上评估OptScientist，这是一个由99个源自物理学的优化问题构成的新基准。在该基准上，OptScientist对超过80%的问题恢复了真实规律，并且对含噪声的上下文信息保持稳健，同时大幅优于基于机器学习、符号方法和LLM的模型发现基线。 在人类风险决策与央行货币政策任务上，OptScientist发现了简洁的符号化优化规律，其留出集预测性能可与领先的基线相媲美，同时使用的参数很少，且消耗的token远少于LLM基线。 总体而言，OptScientist将自动化科学发现扩展到揭示生成所观测现象的优化规律，从而实现跨物理、生物、行为与社会科学的自动化理论构建。
